facts.text: Lebanon Valley College guarantees full-time, non-transfer students can complete requirements for the baccalaureate degree in four academic years, or the college provides additional courses needed without charge.

sources.title: Four-Year Guarantee | Admission and Financial Aid
sources.quote: At LVC, we make sure full-time, non-transfer students can complete requirements for the baccalaureate degree in four academic years (eight semesters), or we'll provide the additional courses needed for the degree without charge.
